answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. What survives to the pigment is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, slashed on a failed audit, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Work waits on the lantern until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the zephyr of the next round.
